type Namer<ConfigType> = {
  name(args: {
    bundle: Bundle;
    bundleGraph: BundleGraph;
    config: ConfigType;
    options: PluginOptions;
  }): Async<FilePath | null | undefined>;

Return a file path for bundle, relative to its target's distDir, or nullish or "" to leave it to the next namer plugin. A path that leaves the distDir, e.g. an absolute one, fails the build.
